description: One recipe in full, migrated to schema 2: the recipe, two plain lines of summary, the accounts it is the default for, and its cover (state, the cover.gif details and a private link good for an hour to the looping GIF). id is a workspace recipe's id (see recipe_list) or house:<id>.

id.description: A workspace recipe's id or name, or house:<id>

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: recipe_get
title: Get a recipe
